name: matched-ks3-all-warpminus0025
hypothesis: Initialize only KS3 warp coefficient c4 to -0.025 instead of zero at every dense and routed site. This adds 0.025 - 0.05*z^2 before squared ReLU, opening small activations and damping saturated ones while enabling warp gradients immediately. Test a modest learned-basis initialization change at unchanged width 1024, rank one, projection multiplier 1.0 and geometry Adam multiplier 0.125. Shared/model-wide settings stay frozen.
